notes: Printed: 'Double the power of target creature until end of turn.' CR 701.10b: the creature gets +X/+0 where X is its power AS THE SPELL RESOLVES. Hellkite Punisher 6/6 doubled -> 12/6 (+6/+0, locked). Its own '{R}: +1/+0 until end of turn' afterwards -> 13/6. A doubling bonus that re-reads the creature's current power would give 14 or more.
